info.description: Generate the shopping list for a user from the meal planner in a given time frame.
info.title: spoonacular API

requests.description: This endpoint can be used to have a conversation about food with the spoonacular chatbot. Use the "Get Conversation Suggests" endpoint to show your user what he or she can say.
requests.name: Talk to Chatbot

requests.description: This endpoint returns suggestions for things the user can say or ask the chatbot.
requests.name: Conversation Suggests

requests.description: Search custom foods in a user's account.
requests.name: Search Custom Foods

requests.description: Take any text and find all mentions of food contained within it. This task is also called Named Entity Recognition (NER). In this case, the entities are foods. Either dishes, such as pizza or cheeseburger, or ingredients, such as cucumber or almonds.
requests.name: Detect Food in Text

requests.description: Analyze a food image. The API tries to classify the image, guess the nutrition, and find a matching recipes.
requests.name: Image Analysis by URL

requests.description: Classify a food image.
requests.name: Image Classification by URL

requests.description: Autocomplete the entry of an ingredient.
requests.name: Autocomplete Ingredient Search

requests.description: Retrieve the glycemic index for a list of ingredients and compute the individual and total glycemic load.
requests.name: Compute Glycemic Load

requests.description: Map a set of ingredients to products you can buy in the grocery store.
requests.name: Map Ingredients to Grocery Products

requests.description: Search for simple whole foods (e.g. fruits, vegetables, nuts, grains, meat, fish, dairy etc.).
requests.name: Ingredient Search

requests.description: Search for substitutes for a given ingredient.
requests.name: Get Ingredient Substitutes

requests.description: Compute the amount you need of a certain ingredient for a certain nutritional goal. For example, how much pineapple do you have to eat to get 10 grams of protein?
requests.name: Compute Ingredient Amount
requests.note: Replace {{SPOONACULAR_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Use an ingredient id to get all available information about an ingredient, such as its image and supermarket aisle.
requests.name: Get Ingredient Information
requests.note: Replace {{SPOONACULAR_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Search for substitutes for a given ingredient.
requests.name: Get Ingredient Substitutes by ID
requests.note: Replace {{SPOONACULAR_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Get a random joke that is related to food. Caution: this is an endpoint for adults!
requests.name: Random Food Joke

requests.description: Search over 115,000 menu items from over 800 fast food and chain restaurants. For example, McDonald's Big Mac or Starbucks Mocha.
requests.name: Search Menu Items

requests.description: Generate suggestions for menu items based on a (partial) query. The matches will be found by looking in the title only.
requests.name: Autocomplete Menu Item Search

requests.description: Use a menu item id to get all available information about a menu item, such as nutrition.
requests.name: Get Menu Item Information
requests.note: Replace {{SPOONACULAR_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Visualize a menu item's nutritional label information as HTML including CSS.

requests.summary: Menu Item Nutrition by ID Image

requests.description: This endpoint allows you to match a packaged food to a basic category, e.g. a specific brand of milk to the category milk.
requests.name: Classify Grocery Product

requests.description: Provide a set of product jsons, get back classified products.
requests.name: Classify Grocery Product Bulk

requests.description: Search packaged food products, such as frozen pizza or Greek yogurt.
requests.name: Search Grocery Products

requests.description: Generate suggestions for grocery products based on a (partial) query. The matches will be found by looking in the title only.

requests.description: Get information about a packaged food using its UPC.

requests.description: Find comparable products to the given one.
requests.name: Get Comparable Products
requests.note: Replace {{SPOONACULAR_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Use a product id to get full information about a product, such as ingredients, nutrition, etc. The nutritional information is per serving.
requests.name: Get Product Information

requests.description: Search through thousands of restaurants (in North America) by location, cuisine, budget, and more.
requests.name: Search Restaurants

requests.description: Search all food content with one call. That includes recipes, grocery products, menu items, simple foods (ingredients), and food videos.
requests.name: Search All Food

requests.description: Search spoonacular's site content. You'll be able to find everything that you could also find using the search suggestions on spoonacular.com. This is a suggest API so you can send partial strings as queries.
requests.name: Search Site Content

requests.description: Returns random food trivia.
requests.name: Random Food Trivia

requests.description: Find recipe and other food related videos.
requests.name: Search Food Videos
requests.note: Replace {{SPOONACULAR_API_KEY}} with your API key | Set Content-Type to multipart/form-data for file uploads

requests.description: Get a simple description of a certain wine, e.g. "malbec", "riesling", or "merlot".
requests.name: Wine Description

requests.description: Find a dish that goes well with a given wine.
requests.name: Dish Pairing for Wine

requests.description: Find a wine that goes well with a food. Food can be a dish name ("steak"), an ingredient name ("salmon"), or a cuisine ("italian").
requests.name: Wine Pairing

requests.description: Get a specific wine recommendation (concrete product) for a given wine type, e.g. "merlot".
requests.name: Wine Recommendation

requests.description: Generate a meal plan with three meals per day (breakfast, lunch, and dinner).
